# wanix_instance (Resource)

Manages a pop.wanix.net/v1alpha1 Instance using full Kubernetes updates instead of merge patches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wanix_instance" "outbound" {
  name      = "outbound"
  namespace = "default"

  labels = {
    "sdwan.wanix.net/id" = "123"
  }

  spec = {
    cpu              = "100m"
    memory           = 4096
    workload_kind    = "StatefulSet"
    disable_workload = false
    pause            = false

    interfaces = {
      region_a = {
        address = "192.0.2.10"
        gateway = "192.0.2.1"
        table   = 222
        default = true
        routes = [
          {
            destination = "198.51.100.0/24"
            gateway     = "192.0.2.1"
          }
        ]
      }
    }

    image_pull_secrets = ["registry-creds"]
    pod_template_annotations = {
      "example.wanix.net/restarted-at" = "2026-04-15T00:00:00Z"
    }
    agent = {
      env = {
        DISABLE_PUBLIC_LISTENER = "true"
      }
    }
  }

  wait_for_ready       = true
  wait_timeout_seconds = 600
}

output "instance_ip" {
  value = try(wanix_instance.outbound.pod_ips[0], null)
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Instance custom resource.
- `spec` (Attributes) Desired state for the pop.wanix.net Instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations managed on the Instance custom resource.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels managed on the Instance custom resource.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace containing the Instance custom resource.
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Wait for status.phase=Ready and a non-empty status.podIPs list after create or update. Paused instances do not require Pod IPs.
- `wait_timeout_seconds` (Number) Maximum time to wait for reconciliation and deletion.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Kubernetes object ID in the form namespace/name.
- `message` (String) Operator-reported status message.
- `phase` (String) Operator-reported reconciliation phase.
- `pod_ips` (List of String) Primary IP addresses reported by the operator for workload pods.
